dimensions.name: Structure
dimensions.description: How much clarity and direction you prefer before starting work.

dimensions.name: Risk / Experimentation
dimensions.description: How willing you are to explore new ideas and different approaches.

dimensions.name: Autonomy
dimensions.description: How comfortable you are making decisions and working independently.

dimensions.name: Ambiguity
dimensions.description: How well you cope with uncertainty, changing priorities and incomplete information.

dimensions.name: Communication / Collaboration
dimensions.description: How you naturally communicate and work with other people.

dimensions.name: Product Thinking
dimensions.description: How much you focus on understanding business problems before building solutions.

dimensions.name: Execution Style
dimensions.description: Whether you naturally prefer careful planning or rapid delivery and continuous improvement.

dimensions.name: Domain Orientation
dimensions.description: How interested you are in understanding the customer’s business and industry.

dimensions.name: Challenge / Conflict
dimensions.description: How comfortable you are questioning ideas and expressing different opinions.

dimensions.name: AI Working Style
dimensions.description: How you use AI to improve your work while applying your own judgement.

dimensions.name: Learning / Adaptability
dimensions.description: How quickly you embrace new technologies, business domains and ways of working.
